dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: It seems that these strange meteorites have also appeared in Liyue, just as they have in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: How may I help you? I mean, I'm just a merchant from Mondstadt who's in the wine business...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Thank you! Your skills are an inspiration. Now I know how to deal with... difficult people...

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Ah! I miscalculated. But that won't happen again!

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: This is really bad...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to you?

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Oh, you're a traveler... Well, you see, I'm a merchant, and I often shuttle between Mondstadt and Liyue on business.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: I had just closed a big deal in Mondstadt, and was getting ready to deliver the invoices back to my boss...

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: But I never imagined that I'd be attacked by monsters while passing through this area.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: I couldn't fight them off, so I could only flee for my life, and ended up stumbling my way into this inn.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: But I've run off, and left all the invoices behind... Could I ask you to get them back for me?

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: That's wonderful! I remember the places I passed by as I ran, more or less. Here, let me mark them for you...

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: I placed all the invoices inside a box. It shouldn't be too hard to find, so please, help me out!

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: For wine, of course. What other business would one do in Mondstadt, anyway?

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: This is a huge deal. If anything goes wrong, my boss will hang the loss on me for sure.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Please help me out. I've marked all the rough locations out for you.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: I placed all the invoices inside a box. It shouldn't be too hard to find, so please, help me out!

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: My boss? Uh, well, it's a really rich merchant in Liyue. Really rich.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Oh, just don't ask too much. I'm just the errand runner, I don't know that much about the boss.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: But if I mess this one up, I'm going to lose this errand-running job for sure.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Please help me out. I've marked all the rough locations out for you.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: I placed all the invoices inside a box. It shouldn't be too hard to find, so please, help me out!

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Can I help you? As you can see I'm a merchant from Mondstadt — so in the wine business, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: ...Wh—Why are you looking at me like that. I'm telling the truth, I swear...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: My name is Landa, and I'm in the wine business. That girl darting about all over the show is my daughter, Tia.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Did you know that all of Mondstadt's wine exports go via Liyue before being distributed to the rest of the continent?

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: And have you heard of the Morn Winery? That's where it comes from.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: ...Sorry yes, Dawn Winery. Not Morn. Dawn.

choices.text: ...No true child of Mondstadt would make that mistake.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Give me a break, I just haven't been back to Mondstadt in forever is all.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Meanwhile, I've gotten to know this place like the back of my hand. I've traveled this route on business more times than I can remember.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Both the innkeeper and the boss of this place will vouch for me on that!

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Isn't that right, Huai'an? Goldet? Hahahaha...

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: ...Come on, don't leave me hanging now...

choices.text: You get cuter each time you open your mouth.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: ...What a strange thing to say.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Anyway, you want to hear a secret that only someone in the wine business could tell you?

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: "Angel's Share" actually used to be wine brewers' slang before it was the name of a tavern.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: The idea was that the air bubbles you see during fermentation carry away the angel's share when they float off into the wind.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Not bad huh? Vintage Mondstadt knowledge!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whatever you say, I have to go.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: What's that supposed to mean? I'm telling the truth!

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Next time you see me re-stocking in Mondstadt, you'll know I'm the real deal!
